reviews.text: Great experience all around! Patti, the manager, and Dr. Fraser are wonderful! The front desk staff are always welcoming, and the technicians are caring, knowledgeable, and professional. Such a great team that truly cares about their patients and clients. Highly recommend!

I have been bringing all my pets here for the past 10+ years and I have ALWAYS received nothing but the best care and customer service. I moved from Laveen and still drive 45 minutes to bring my kiddos here. Best Vet and Staff in Laveen!

Dr. Fraser and his team are hands-down, the best veterinary team I have ever experienced in my life. They’re all friendly. They all genuinely care about the animals and go above and beyond for their care. I cannot think Dr. Fraser enough for all the help with my kittens. It doesn’t get better than this Vet veterinary office- I’ve been referring him in his team to everybody are coming into contact with.

I have been coming to this hospital with Dr. Fraser for about a year now. He is the only doctor i will eve bring my cat to. He is very detailed and respectful.
The front staff are very kind and the techs are very knowledgeable.  I highly recommend.
The best vet hospital . Thank you for all the care you give our pets. Great staff. Very Friendly. I highly recommend this place!!

I recently made an appointment for my dog (Nala).  I explained to the receptionist that I had recently taken over ownership of my dog because my son had deployed to Saudi Arabia and had not left any paperwork regarding Nala, so i wanted to start over with her vaccinations and wellness care.  I made my appointment and was given a paper with what vaccinations she would receive and the price.  On the day of my appointment the technician quoted me a different price which was higher.  I agreed and told them to proceed.  When Nala was returned I noticed that her nails were not clipped.  I told the technician that part of the quote I was given included Nala's nailed clipped.  I informed him that it was written in the quote I was initially given and an additional $35 goes over $60 that I was quoted.  The technician became argumentative and stated in front of my wife that he knows what he wrote down and that he had not written nail clips in the quote.  I asked to see the Vet and was informed that if I wanted to see the supervisor i could come in on Monday.  I left very unsatisfied and felt that I had been scammed.

Monday I received a text whom I suspect was the supervisor and explained my concern.  The response was that I signed the agreement on the day of the appointment and could not understand my concern.  I attempted to explain to her that what was initially quoted was much higher than what it came to be on the day of the appointment.  Furthermore, that the technician had become very argumentative and blatantly disputed what I was telling him on what had been quoted when I made my appointment.  He stated he knew what he wrote and what I was saying he wrote was not true.   I sent a picture to the person that text me and showed what was on the sheet given to me.  I received not response.  I then asked if this was acceptable behavior from the employees there and received no response.  My last request was to get the name of the owner or in charge and still not response.
I am very disappointed in this organization and would not recommend it to anyone in the future.

Mario S
Laveen Resident
US Army Retired
Found a puppy by my house a few days ago, the people at the front desk were super sweet and helpful.
Is the second time that we go to this hospital and both times we were very please!

After a bad experience with another vet, Dr. Fraser was amazing. He gave in depth explanations of everything, without having to ask and just had a genuinely nice demeanor. Just moved here and this will be our new vet for sure. New client discount was exceptionally nice as well after being overcharged at the last vet. Great place.
The front office is always so kind. The vet techs are gentle with my little fur baby and I know they will take good care of her.
For nearly 7 years we've taken out pets to Animal Hospital of Laveen. We have always received excellent care for our dog and many cats over the years. I highly recommend this office!

Went in a few days ago because my dog was not feeling well. The team was super friendly and the doctor was very knowledgeable. Buddy is doing much better now and recovering quickly. I will definitely be bringing him back to this location again.
Hi, Claudia. Your feedback is highly appreciated. Thank you so much for the review.
I appreciate the attentiveness and compassion demonstrated by each staff member.  I have been a client for over 15 years and am extremely pleased.

Absolutely lovely, knowledgeable and caring staff! Thank u for everything 🐱 Love
Wink …
Same day appointment, cost effective, and very friendly and efficient servce. Thank you!

Triple book appointments for able to make the money. Customer service terrible.
You sit with an animal for over a hour and tell me why the appointment is late. A doctor use to be a person to help. Now it's a money machine.
Dr. Fraser is amazing.  Very good at what he does, and sincerely cares about the patients and owners.  I switched vets because of his great service.

The staff at Animal Hospital of Laveen are wonderful, kind, and compassionate. They have a deep care for my pet's health and empathy when they are sick. Thank you for being there when my little guys need you.

8-28-2026: I had an emergency with one of my furbabies and they were able to get him right in and start his treatment. He was tough a go at first but they didn't give up and my baby is now home resting. They reached out the day after to make sure he was doing ok which meant so much to me because it was a Saturday night! Thank you all for the compassion and love you have for our furbabies.

The service and doctors at AH of Laveen are always professional and helpful with my Duke.  One of the assistants helped carry in Duke from my car because he has IVDD and cannot walk well.  They are always very caring with Duke.

I truly cannot say enough good things about Dr. Clifford Fraser. There really are genuinely good people left in this world, and he is absolutely one of them. The care, kindness, and compassion he showed my dog throughout multiple visits for an ear hematoma meant more to me than I can put into words. What started as an ongoing issue required several visits and eventually surgery, and Dr. Fraser was there helping us through the entire process. He went above and beyond to make sure my dog received the care he needed every step of the way.

Dr. Fraser didn’t just treat my dog like another patient. It was very clear that he genuinely cared about him and about what we were going through. His patience, generosity, and willingness to help made an incredibly stressful situation so much easier for me.

I am beyond grateful for everything he did for my dog and for me. It is rare to come across someone who shows this level of compassion and truly cares about the people and animals they are helping. I will never forget the kindness Dr. Fraser showed us, and I cannot thank him enough. I would recommend him without hesitation to anyone looking for a veterinarian who truly has a heart for what he does. ❤️
Dr. Fraser is the best, he takes care of all of our kitties. We will always go to him for our pet needs.

I love this animal hospital, they are reasonably priced.
The staff are all so very kind. I've met 3 different Veterinarians and loved them all.

I brought my dog in for a wellness check up and never got an actual checkup! No checking her ears now feeling around for lumps or anything out of the ordinary no looking on her mouth or at her teeth just a summary of what it would cost to remove a large growth she's had on her hip since birth and a small lump that  was diagnosed by another vet as cancer .$2700 !! They were running a special for $50 off first visit and I still paid $65 !! The lack of attention to my dog is the part that bothers me! The Vet was in and out  in 5 minutes!
For the record, I don't like to write bad reviews but I thought this justified!

I am truly grateful for the exceptional care provided by this veterinary team. Dr Fraser, the veterinarian is knowledgeable, compassionate, and always takes the time to explain things clearly. The staff is just as wonderful--kind, patient, and genuinely dedicated to making every visit comfortable for both pets and owners. Their professionalism and warmth make all the difference. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for outstanding veterinary care.

As long as I live in Laveen I won’t ever take my dogs somewhere else. I was there everyday with one of my dogs when he got super sick and everyone was very helpful and the veterinarians that were involved took their time until we eventually got our answer. Now my 10 year old shepherd runs around like he’s a puppy again thanks to Animal hospital of Laveen!

Staff were rude, unhelpful and showed no care towards my pet. I was shouted at by the technician when I shared that I would leave after waiting half an hour and’s song for the door to be opened because I am disabled. They were very hostile and no one even asked how my pet was.  I feel sorry for any animal under such care when they don’t even pretend to care. Awful
everyone was kind and attentive to my pet Dante and to myself

Animal Hospital of Laveen is amazing. The staff is super kind, the vets are thorough, and the prices are fair. I have unfortunately had to bring both of my dogs in for urgent care over the last few months and they were able to get me in on the same day both times, even though we were not established clients when we took my first dog(I couldn't get ahold of my regular vet). I'll definitely be continuing to bring both of my dogs here for their future care.

Thank you to the docs and team who treated both Archie & Raya! 💚

I took my dog to get some anxiety meds for the Fourth of July fireworks. The doctor examined her and took time to notice abnormalities. He let me know she had a cancerous tumor in her spleen. I was able to take her to our surgical vet who also confirmed it. They removed the tumor and she’s currently healing up. It was sheer luck that brought me in and had the doctor not been so thorough we wouldn’t have known until it was too late. I can thank him enough for saving my girl.

New patient here. I came in for a follow up appointment for my dog's cornea eye area. My dog had a deep scratch visibly red and squinting. The vet hospital prescribed her eyedrops and ointment. My appt was at 9:30am, checked in early and was not seen until 9:50am. The entire appt lasted about 6 mins with Dr. Clifford Fraser. I asked Dr. Clifford Fraser his opinion on my dog's eye injury. He responded, "you tell me, what do you think?" I have never had an interaction with Dr. Clifford Fraser before he was new to me. I again asked him politely since HE is the doctor not me on his expertise, he again asked me "what do you see, you tell me?" He was very rude, speaking to me as if I was stupid. I spent a lot of money on my dog's eye treatment and appointment. The front office staff told me Dr. Clifford Fraser can be rude and that some days you don't know what mood you will get from him. The rest of the staff and other Dr's are extremely polite and professional. Please do not waste your time with Dr. Clifford Fraser he has horrible customer service.

I cannot say enough positive about this office. I have a difficult dog and they can deal with him without sedation. He came in this past week and was behind beyond I truly thought I was going to lose him the staff including Mario and Dino were able to get everything done and eventhough he’s still recovering he is  still with us!!! Dr Fraser and the entire staff go above and beyond
They get you in quickly when needed!  Thank you!
Staff is always friendly and helpful, and love that Dr. Watson is back.

will not be coming back

I have had two of my cats (Ben/Kev) fixed here at two different times and both experiences were not very great. The first time with Ben my partner was the one to pick him up but expressed that the doctor never spoke to them. We werent given much information about aftercare and what to expect as Ben was actively bleeding 7 days after procedure and it was horrific how much he bled everywhere, when notifying the clinic I was told its normal but Ive grown up with neumerous cats and thats never happened. When we brought our boy Kev my partner and I were the first to drop off an animal when opening yet the very last tended too as they were about to close. The doctor ignored my partner and I numerous times and disregarded our attendance in the clinic- quite literally... looking at us knowing we are waiting to speak to him... Just to tend to people who walked in the door an hour after my partner and I have. When he finally spoke to us it was rude, rushed and disregarding as hell. When it came to Ben it was a similar experience. With both, I felt like a burden contacting to see the well-being of my pet durring the day of the procedure and it shouldn't be that way. I would not recommend this location and would urge you to trust clinics where the doctor and staff show they care about your pets!
The Doctors are friendly, it may look like Olic will have a full recovery after not eating for a week.  the Mirataz is working and our cat is eating and pooping regularly.  Thanks for the expertise.
Very friendly and just awesome care. Love Dr. Fraser

The care is fine if you have tons of extra time on your hands. Appointment at 4 and didn’t see someone for 40 minutes. After the doctor evaluated my dog, which was about three minutes, we waited almost another 15 min as they worked on the estimate. I ended up leaving after being there for an hour and will no be continuing care there.

Dr. Fraser and Tech Mario were so supportive and thorough, compassionate and explanatory. I am grandma to an older much loved dog and was quite concerned I was given excellent explanation. Thank you very much. Highly recommend this practice. Thank you.
My dog awoke with a huge lump on his neck the size of a baseball. The vet diagnosed him and performed surgery to drain the abscess the same day. Awesome job!

First time visit to Animal Hospital of Laveen I found the staff to be really nice and helpful. Veterinarian Fraser was super nice and helpful in explaining the situation with my fur baby. He gave me my options on what procedures I could pick and choose with no pressure. I was happy with the recovery of my fur baby and will continue to use the services of this animal hospital for my other babies.

My experience in the office was exceptional. The staff was friendly and professional and I particularly like the doctor. Originally gave a 2 star rating because we paid for labs and ultrasound (I think) and we’re on the 4th day waiting for a callback on the lab results.  Spoke with the doctor today and returned for follow up. Doctor Fraser was extremely thorough and caring.

This clinic is a true gem. Everyone here genuinely cares about your pet’s well-being. Dr. Fraser is not only passionate but incredibly thorough, he takes the time to explain everything clearly, so you walk away informed and reassured. He only recommends tests that are truly necessary, which we really appreciated. The vet techs are just as kind and attentive, and the pricing is very reasonable. We’re so grateful to have found a place that puts compassion and integrity first.

If you're looking for collaborative and compassionate pet care, I would not recommend this veterinary office. While our previous visits were satisfactory, our most recent experience was very disappointing. The vet was dismissive and argumentative when I voiced concerns about the high cost and necessity of a medication he was strongly pushing. I felt that my input as a pet owner was not valued. Unfortunately, it seemed like selling expensive, possibly unnecessary treatments was prioritized over what’s truly best for our pet. We won’t be returning.
They are expensive but they are really good with the quality of their work.  The surgeon could use some improvement with the way he communicates with customers.
Brief visit for vaccinations. Efficient and troublefree.

Overall I had a good experience. Front desk staff and vet tech were fantastic and communicated very well. My only complaint was the actual vet was with me and my dog for under a minute in the room. It was just a yearly check up/vaccines so there wasn’t a ton to do, but it felt very rushed. I don’t think he even told me his name. If he did, I don’t remember it. He did seem busy/running behind so that could have contributed. I’ll definitely be back though with my other pups and hopefully this was a one time thing because of timing.

The staff here is so nice & time efficient. They are able to move appointments through quickly without making you feel rushed or low they don't care about your pet. They've found a perfect balance. Would definitely recommend.

Dr. Fraiser and the team took really good care of my kitty for her spay. The doctor and staff have positive and professional attitudes yet are mellow and kind as well. Thanks guys!
As always the staff is very nice and on point.
Brought my buddy Oliver in for his annual vaccinations. The appointment was quick. In and out in a timely manner. All of the staff was very nice.
Love that every time we take my granddoggy to the vet she's attended to quickly and professionally, staff is awesome keep up the great job thx from the Zina family

The receptionists were not friendly by any means and the veterinarian had never heard of the breed of dog we have… granted he is a rare breed, however, one would think a vet would know or have at least heard of the breed… We will not go back!!

I have a large mixed breed dog that I have taking here since 2022. The staff is very quick to get us into a room so there aren’t too many animals in the waiting room. It’s usually pretty easy to get an appointment at their office and we are in and out pretty quick. Their prices are much more reasonable than other vets we’ve been to. Definitely recommend if you’re looking for a new vet!
We needed puppy shots for our new puppy...ALL STAFF MEMBERS WERE FABULOUS....VETERNARIAN WAS VERY GENTLE  AS Buster was terrified...Kudos

This was my 1st time visiting the Animal Hospital of Laveen and I didn’t have the greatest experience. The staff was very nice, however they were extremely over booked. I had an appointment scheduled for 4:00, 4:40 comes around and I was still waiting in the waiting room, however people that got there after me were taken back and cared for. Finally, one of the staff members comes out and says that due to them being at capacity, she would start doing the intake there in the waiting room. Then she proceeds to tell me that in order to speed up the process, she can take my dog back and give him his shots but that I would have to wait in the waiting room because there were still no rooms available. This didn’t sit right with me. The lack of coordination and not being able to be with my pup throughout this process made me feel super uneasy. Not sure if I will ever return.
Only the best care for my fur babies.  Doctors and staff are overall top notch.  I highly recommend Animal Hospital of Laveen.

Our regular vet is up north and takes us an hour and a half to go to his yearly checkups. This location is super close to our house, and we are so glad and feel like we scored finding it! Highly recommended!
